sloka: शार्दूलसिंहविव जातदंष्ट्रौ ।गजेन्द्रपोताविव संप्रयुक्तौ ।संहत्य संवेद्य च तौ कराभ्यां ।तऊ पेतुतुर्वै युगपद्धरायाम् ।। ६-४०-१९।।
transliteration: śārdūlasiṁhaviva jātadaṁṣṭrau ।gajendrapotāviva saṁprayuktau ।saṁhatya saṁvedya ca tau karābhyāṁ ।taū petuturvai yugapaddharāyām ।। 6-40-19।।

translations.english: Both of them resembled a tiger and lion affected by pride, connecting to each other through their shoulders like Lordly elephants, hitting and hurting one another holding one another fell down at once simultaneously.
